author: test-reviewer

findings.description: Test method name is an implementation name, not a behavior name. The brief (docs/testing-principles.md § Test Naming) mandates the BDD school `the{Subject}Should{Outcome}` for all tests written or modified from 2026-07-31 onward. `processFindFormWithPageBelowOneReturnsFirstPage` names the production method rather than stating what must be true. A reader cannot tell from the name what invariant the fix protects.

The test calls `new Owner()` directly. The brief (docs/testing-principles.md § Factory Methods) prohibits raw production constructor calls in tests written or modified from 2026-07-31 onward. The new test is within that window and must wrap construction behind a factory method (e.g. `createAnOwner()`).

Local variable is named `tasks` in a test about owners. This is a Tier 3 mystery name (copy-paste artifact from another test). Per docs/testing-principles.md § Three-Tier Data Naming, role-describing names are required for variables that feed the act phase. Rename to `matchingOwners` or similar.
findings.fix: Rename `Page<Owner> tasks` to `Page<Owner> matchingOwners` (and update its usages in the stub and assertion chain if any).

findings.description: No blank line separates the Arrange phase (stub setup) from the Act phase (mockMvc.perform). The brief (docs/testing-principles.md § Four-Phase Test Structure) requires phases to be separated by blank lines so the structure reads without comments.
findings.fix: Add a blank line between the `when(...)` stub line and the `mockMvc.perform(...)` call.

findings.description: The fix clamps all values below 1 (`Math.max(page, 1)`), but the test only exercises `page=0`. A parameterized test covering at least one negative value (e.g. `page=-5`) would pin the full clamping range and guard against a future regression that special-cases zero without handling negatives. Consider a `@ParameterizedTest` with `@ValueSource(ints = {0, -1, -5, Integer.MIN_VALUE})`.
findings.fix: Convert to `@ParameterizedTest @ValueSource(ints = {0, -1, -5})` and rename the method to reflect the full range: `theOwnerListShouldShowFirstPageWhenRequestedPageIsBelowOne`.

approved_aspects: The production fix (`Math.max(page, 1)`) correctly clamps the page at the controller boundary before any downstream logic runs
The test exercises the HTTP boundary (real MockMvc dispatch) rather than calling the controller method directly — consistent with the existing suite's integration approach
The three asserted attributes (HTTP 200, `currentPage == 1`, view `owners/ownersList`) together reproduce the bug and pin the fix: all three would have failed before the clamp was added
No new mock library is introduced; the test follows the existing stub pattern the brief explicitly tolerates
`george()` reuses the existing factory method; only the second Owner is constructed raw
